name: bizplug-pest-control
description: The pest control plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: estimate treatment and request a visit. It works from the business's own published profile, covering treatments, safety and inspection requests, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.
